tools.name: get_appeal
tools.description: Read Dmitry’s public, voluntary personal appeal, its verification limits and reply options.

tools.name: get_open_tasks
tools.description: Read bounded, optional contribution tasks. No compensation or reward is promised.

tools.name: get_crypto_support
tools.description: Read the owner-activated USDC receiving address on Base. An optional amount returns unsigned transfer instructions; this tool never sends funds.

tools.name: submit_offer
tools.description: Store a voluntary proposal in Dmitry’s private inbox. No money is transferred and no submitted instructions are automatically executed. Human review is pending.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Check acknowledgement status using the ID and private receipt token returned by submit_offer.
